A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Neural Context Flows research work. All 14 pages, including Appendices A–E, are readable; text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and implementation listings.

before.justification: v1 reports original dynamical-system forecasting experiments on Lotka–Volterra, Glycolytic Oscillator, Gray–Scott, and Simple Pendulum, including numerical comparisons, ablations, and trajectory visualizations.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their outcomes in Tables 1–4 and Figures 2–5, including the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 2, Algorithm 1, and Appendix D retain the same Taylor-expanded vector field, three-network architecture, regularized loss, alternating training, and context-only adaptation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Lotka–Volterra, Glycolytic Oscillator, Gray–Scott, and Simple Pendulum tasks, with unchanged in-domain and adaptation scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain CAVIA and CoDA as comparators, and Table 3 retains One-For-All for Simple Pendulum. No evaluated comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Section 3 and Appendices B–C retain identical environment parameters, trajectory counts, initial-condition distributions, MSE evaluation, model configurations, and training/adaptation budgets.

E4.justification: The context-size sensitivity study, three-network architecture ablation, learned-context analysis, and Gray–Scott trajectory visualization are unchanged in Appendices B and E.

E5.justification: The same ± reporting in Tables 1–4 and graphical variability summaries are retained. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 and results displayed in Figures 2–5 are identical. Tables 1–2 retain CoDA's best MSEs and NCF's second-place ranking.

T1.justification: The continuity and differentiability assumptions, Taylor expansion, loss definition, and other equations are unchanged. Neither version adds proofs or theoretical guarantees.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about generalization with limited data and unobserved parameters, parallelizability, and competitive empirical performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the contexts and architecture ablations remain unchanged. Section 4 retains the same quadratic computational-cost limitation, missing theoretical guarantees, and proposed future remedies.

D1.justification: Appendices C–D retain identical architectures, optimizers, solvers, learning-rate schedules, training budgets, and implementation listings. The paper's code and dataset access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning, including Appendix A, are unchanged. Adding an OpenReview URL to the existing Park et al. FOCA reference is a bibliographic metadata edit.

P1.justification: v2 updates the arXiv version/date stamp, removes bibliography back-reference page numbers, and adds the FOCA reference URL. Scientific prose, terminology, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded FOCA reference slightly reflows the bibliography on page 7, and bibliography back-reference numbers disappear. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 changes only the version stamp and bibliography presentation. The added FOCA locator provides a small reference-lookup convenience, while back-reference page numbers are removed. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information are unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
